text:
maria: FYI RC-2026.03.23 is failing in the integration pipeline, blocking promote. Observed repeated failures in the analytics seed + cache layer.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #4723 FAILED - stage: integration (tests). Job: integration-analytics. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4723

sam: thanks — any obvious error in the logs or is it timing/flaky?

maria: looks like a KV cache eviction race, test hits a missing prefix then retries and fails intermittently. paste: ```
E 12:34:56 analytics_test.go:421: expected 42, got 0
W 12:34:56 cache.go:88: missing prefix key shard=5 key=projects:12345:seed
E 12:34:57 retry: exceeded 2 attempts
```

alex: hmm that cache warning lines up with the recent cache-sharding change in canary. Did the canary hit the same workers?

jin: yes, canary was on the same fleet. We saw one eviction spike earlier today; I pushed a softlimit tweak to staging but not prod.

drew: is this blocking the release immediately or can we promote and hotfix? change window is open for the hour.

maria: it's failing integration which gates promote. Options: 1) pin to last-good image (2026.03.20) and promote, 2) rerun the pipeline with more retries & skip flaky test, 3) revert the cache-sharding change and rerun, 4) hotfix small delay in seed logic + quick canary then promote.

sam: pining sounds lowest risk. How much churn would that cause to release notes?

maria: minimal — pin is only to the runtime image used by integration (not model binary). We'll note in release notes: "pin runtime image to 2026.03.20 due to KV cache sharding regression; plan to unpin after cache fix."

alex: if we pin we should also schedule a follow-up to unpin and roll out the cache fix behind a canary flag. I'll own the rollback/unpin plan.

jin: I can push the cache fix but need ~2 dev hours + canary. If we pin now, I'll deploy the fix to staging and start canary right away.

drew: deploy-bot: can you run promote with pinned-image=2026.03.20 and set retry=3 on integration?

deploy-bot: Received promote request: promote RC-2026.03.23 -> prod with override {pinned_image: "2026.03.20", integration_retries: 3}. Kicking off dry-run checks...

deploy-bot: Dry-run OK. Starting promote pipeline. Monitor: https://ci.redwood/internal/4724

sam: also add a release note blurb and mark the change window; I'll draft the note.

maria: quick checklist: (1) pin and promote now, (2) jin implements cache fix and runs canary, (3) alex coordinates unpin/rollforward, (4) sam updates release notes + changelog.

alex: noted — target unpin window tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll create a follow-up issue and link here.

jin: starting work on fix now, ETA ~2h, will post canary results.

drew: marking this thread: action=pin-promote, owner=maria, followup=cache-unpin-ticket

maria: thanks everyone. If promote succeeds I'll merge release notes and close the window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promote pipeline completed: SUCCESS. RC-2026.03.23 promoted to prod with pinned_image=2026.03.20. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release/rc-2026.03.23/draft

sam: nice. I'll finish the release notes and ping #product for visibility.

jin: canary started on 3 nodes, initial health OK. Will update in ~45m.

maria: closing this thread for the immediate promote. Follow-up ticket: ENG-4312 cache-shard-unpin (alex).
